name: Unconfirmed features probe
description: The features that have only ever been build-verified, each set to a value too large to misread, all reachable in one run. Written before the playtest so each outcome has exactly one meaning. stat_curve: Sonic speed x10, so Adv_Sonic level 2 goes 9 -> 90; it must be read at LEVEL 2, because creatures.GDA row 0 carries a duplicate of the level-1 line (7/8/14/33/8/2/3) and level 1 therefore cannot distinguish the two sources - the same trap that made an earlier check of Omega's level-1 HP prove nothing. CONFIRMED 2026-10-12: the level-up screen read Speed +20 and Sonic arrived at level 2 with 27, which is creature base 7 + (90 - 70); the table holds increments, not stats. pp_curve: base set to 20, so the pool reads 20 where vanilla reads 7 - `base` replaces the creature row's value rather than adding to it. CONFIRMED 2026-10-12: PP 20/20 at level 1. movement_slots: Fly at level 3 in Sonic's empty slot 2, which vanilla never gives him; UNRESOLVED - the data is right in the ROM (creatures row 0 col 20 = 2, Adv_Sonic col 13 = 3 at every level) but the overworld ability button reads greyed, so the decisive check is Sonic's PROFILE screen, which is the same screen that showed 'Teleport LV 1' when the 2026-10-07 Shadow swap filled this exact slot. store_stock: three late-game items appended to Store1 (Central City - identified by its vanilla Health Seed and POW Candy rows, the pair named in the 2026-10-10 randomize_shops confirmation) at 1 ring each. This is the only feature that APPENDS rows rather than rewriting them, so it is the only one that tests whether the game reads a row count from the table header or has one baked in elsewhere; randomize_shops can never answer that, because a shuffle never changes the row count. Outcomes fixed in advance: 22 rows with Titanium Claws, Nocturne Blade and Immunity Idol at the end = store_stock works; the vanilla 19 rows = the count is read from somewhere else and appending is not enough; blank or garbled rows, or a hang entering the shop = the count is honored but the appended rows are malformed. 1 ring each so a starting wallet can buy all three, which also tests that an appended row is fully functional and not merely drawn. xp_rate 3 is a convenience only - it lowers thresholds so level 2 arrives at 67 XP instead of 200, and touches column 2 while the stats live in columns 3-10.
